method: New independent sock shells cropped from each exact original Body foot and lower-leg surface, with interpolated original skin weights, a thin outside layer, and a closed cuff rim. Existing pants or shoe geometry is not renamed or used as the sock mesh.
attribution: VRoid Project original beta bases; retained third-party export provenance. Sock construction and plain material authored for this project.
texturePolicy: No source skin texture is copied, modified or recolored. The independent socks have one new plain material. Original Body may already contain painted sock color and remains intact.
coordinates: Original glTF right-handed metres, +Y up, original avatar front -Z. Raw skeleton and inverse bind matrices retain their exact source identities.
limits: Exact original female and male bases only
Source/rest checks do not admit game movement, shoe/pants compatibility or visual quality
